crossRefs.note: Only be sure that you don’t eat the blood; for the blood is the life. You shall not eat the life with the meat.
You shall not eat it. You shall pour it out on the earth like water.
Only you shall not eat its blood. You shall pour it out on the ground like water.
But flesh with its life, that is, its blood, you shall not eat.
You shall not eat any blood, whether it is of bird or of animal, in any of your dwellings.
Whoever it is who eats any blood, that soul shall be cut off from his people.’ ”
“ ‘Any man of the house of Israel, or of the strangers who live as foreigners among them, who eats any kind of blood, I…
that you abstain from things sacrificed to idols, from blood, from things strangled, and from sexual immorality, from…
For every creature of God is good, and nothing is to be rejected, if it is received with thanksgiving.

translations.web: Only you shall not eat the blood. You shall pour it out on the earth like water.
translations.bsb: but you must not eat the blood; pour it on the ground like water.
translations.kjv: Only ye shall not eat the blood; ye shall pour it upon the earth as water.
translations.asv: Only ye shall not eat the blood; thou shalt pour it out upon the earth as water.
